text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when Katsuragi Ace and I returned from off-campus training...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
The person over there is......—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of Katsuragi Ace's gaze were two Umamusume.
They were standing by the school gates, staring toward the academy...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I knew it...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's the locals!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heeey!

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Wah!? A-Ace!?"

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wait, I'm not mentally prepared yet...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since we couldn't just stand around talking,
I guided Katsuragi Ace's two friends
to the Trainer's room—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's been a while!
What are you two doing here? On vacation?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. These two,
they're the guys I used to run a team with.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, remember that story about the traveling race clinic
visiting my hometown and me running a race?
Back then, we were also together—

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: —Sorry! Ace!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh—
W-What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"We, uh... we've really been
wanting to apologize to Ace this whole time."

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: To say sorry for the awful things I said back then...

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...It can't be helped, Ace.
It's not like we've ever run on a racecourse before..."

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...There was no way it was gonna be a contest.
Out there... it's a completely different world from ours."

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...Even though we gave up on the race early on,
Ace kept pushing forward after that—

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Even when she was accepted into Tracen Academy,
we felt distant from Ace instead and couldn't even give her a proper send-off...

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Even after that, I kept watching Ace through the TV screen as if she were in a completely "different world," but—

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I was so shocked watching the Japan Cup the other day.
Ace, running in the lead, was smiling—"

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: She had the exact same look as Ace did back when she ran with us. All those memories from back then just came rushing back...—

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing Ace run on TV made me realize
she's the same Ace we know, not someone
from a 'different world.'"

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...And then, after that,
I just really wanted to apologize for the past.
I couldn't just sit still, so—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“—So that's why you went out of your way
to come all the way to Tracen Academy.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Speaking of which, you know...
I'm really grateful to the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: If the two of you hadn't run with me... If you hadn't said those things to me... I might not be standing here right now.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
To me, you two were the very first spark
that led to who I am today.
...Even if that doesn't make ya feel too great.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So, y'know, don't sweat it!
I ain't sweat'n it either!!
In fact, thanks! That's all!!

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ace...—

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
............Listen.
Actually, the two of us are planning to move to Tokyo together.
We're aiming for the same university.

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: We were talking about wanting to start a business back home in the future. You know, with depopulation and all that going on? We hated the idea of just standing by and watching—

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "...I thought about how I have to fight without giving up, just like Ace."

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...We're gonna do our best in our own way.
So Ace, you do your best in the Arima Kinen too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
We're all rootin' for ya!
Our hometown "Ace"!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks.
Seriously... I'm super happy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just like during the Japan Cup...
I'm gonna fight with the running style of an ace!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Embracing their feelings as the 'Ace' once more,
Katsuragi Ace surges forward—"
